user.title: Connect to Immich Picture
user.description: Enter your Immich server address and API key. You can generate an API key in Immich under Account Settings → API Keys.

data_description.host: Full URL including port, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:2283

endpoint.title: Choose API Endpoint
endpoint.description: Select which Immich API endpoint the slideshow will use to retrieve photos.

random_params.title: Random Assets – Options
random_params.description:
Configure how many random photos to load each refresh cycle. Optionally provide a JSON body to filter results (e.g. by person). Example: {example}

[API documentation]({docs_url})

all_params.title: All Assets – Options
all_params.description: Configure how many assets to load and the sort order.

album_params.title: Album Assets – Options
album_params.description: Select the album to use as the photo source.

favorites_params.title: Favorite Assets – Options
favorites_params.description: Configure how many favorite photos to load each refresh cycle.

search_params.title: Search Metadata – Options
search_params.description:
Provide a JSON object of Immich search metadata fields. Example: {example}

[API documentation]({docs_url})

memories_params.title: Memory Assets – Options
memories_params.description: Configure how many memories to load each refresh cycle. Each memory may contain multiple assets. The 'For' date filters memories to a specific date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2024-06-15T00:00:00Z).

intervals.title: Timing
intervals.description: Set how often the displayed photo rotates and how often new photos are fetched from Immich Picture.

layout.title: Card Orientation
layout.description: Tell the integration which way round the dashboard card is. Photos matching that shape are shown as they are; photos of the other shape can be combined two at a time into one composite (portraits side-by-side, landscapes stacked), shown as they are, or skipped altogether.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Immich. Check the URL and ensure Immich is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Please check your Immich API key.
error.cannot_fetch_albums: Could not load albums from Immich. The entry was left empty; you may type an album ID manually.
error.invalid_json: Must be a valid JSON object, e.g. {"city": "Paris"}
error.invalid_datetime: Must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2024-06-15T00:00:00Z

abort.already_configured: This Immich Picture instance is already configured.

data_description.crossfade_enabled: Dissolve one photo into the next instead of cutting straight to it. The blend is rendered as your dashboard refreshes the image, so how smooth it looks depends on how often the client polls.
data_description.crossfade_duration: How long the dissolve takes. Capped at the rotation interval.
data_description.api_params: JSON body sent with each API request. See [API documentation]({docs_url}) for available fields.
data_description.orientation: The shape of the dashboard card the slideshow is shown in.
data_description.mismatch_handling: What to do with photos that do not match the card orientation: combine two into one composite (portraits side-by-side, landscapes stacked), show them as they are, or skip them.
